Frequently asked questions About Hair Strengthening Serum What is a biphasic hair serum? A biphasic serum has two complementary phases. One hydrates, while the other smoothens. Together, they help soften rough lengths and control frizz. Why should I shake the bottle before use? Shaking helps blend the formula evenly before application. Shake the bottle well before every use for best results. How does this serum help with frizz and damaged hair? It helps control frizz and reduce flyaways while caring for rough, damaged lengths, leaving your hair feeling softer and smoother. Should I apply this serum on damp or dry hair? For best results, apply the serum on damp hair, distributing it evenly from the mid-lengths to the ends. You can also use it on dry hair if required. How often should I use this serum? Use it after washing your hair, preferably on damp hair. You can also reapply whenever needed to smooth frizz. Will this serum make my hair oily or weigh it down? The formula is designed to feel lightweight, non-oily and non-greasy. Start with 2–3 pumps and adjust the amount to suit your hair. Should I apply this serum on my scalp or only along my hair lengths? Apply it only from the mid-lengths to the ends of your hair, avoiding the scalp and roots. Should I use this serum before or after styling my hair? Apply it to damp hair as part of your post-wash routine, before styling. Rub the serum between your palms, then distribute evenly through the lengths and ends.
